osa-examples.ifa

Osa: Concurrent Processing

Spawn concurrent tasks, sleep, and wait for all to complete.

Use Case 1: Concurrent Downloads

// downloads.ifa - Simulate parallel downloads

ese download_file(name, time_ms) {
    Irosu.fo("Starting: " + name);
    Osa.sun(time_ms);
    Irosu.fo("Finished: " + name);
    pada name + " complete";
}

// Spawn concurrent tasks
ayanmo t1 = Osa.sa({ -> download_file("image.png", 800) });
ayanmo t2 = Osa.sa({ -> download_file("data.json", 500) });
ayanmo t3 = Osa.sa({ -> download_file("styles.css", 300) });

// Wait for all to finish
Irosu.fo("Waiting for downloads...");
ayanmo results = Osa.gbogbo([t1, t2, t3]);
Irosu.fo("All done: " + results);

Use Case 2: Parallel Workers

// workers.ifa - Spawn worker tasks

ese worker(id, items) {
    fun item ninu items {
        Irosu.fo("Worker " + id + " processing: " + item);
        Osa.sun(Owonrin.pese(200, 500));
    }
    pada "Worker " + id + " done";
}

// Spawn workers
ayanmo w1 = Osa.sa({ -> worker(1, ["A", "B", "C"]) });
ayanmo w2 = Osa.sa({ -> worker(2, ["D", "E", "F"]) });
ayanmo w3 = Osa.sa({ -> worker(3, ["G", "H", "I"]) });

Irosu.fo("All workers started...");
ayanmo results = Osa.gbogbo([w1, w2, w3]);
fun r ninu results {
    Irosu.fo(r);
}

Use Case 3: Actor Model

// actors.ifa - Isolated actor communication

// Spawn an actor that receives messages
ayanmo counter = Osa.egbe({ msg ->
    ti (msg["type"] == "increment") {
        pada {"ok": otito, "message": "counted"};
    } bibẹkọ ti (msg["type"] == "get") {
        pada {"ok": otito, "value": "ok"};
    } bibẹkọ {
        pada {"ok": iro, "error": "unknown"};
    }
});

// Send messages to the actor
ayanmo r1 = Osa.ran(counter, {"type": "increment"});
if (r1["ok"]) {
    Irosu.fo("Incremented: " + r1["message"]);
}

ayanmo r2 = Osa.ran(counter, {"type": "unknown"});
Irosu.fo("Unknown msg: " + r2["error"]);

Use Case 4: Race Condition Demo

// race.ifa - Demonstrate concurrent tasks

ese task(name, delay_ms) {
    Osa.sun(delay_ms);
    Irosu.fo(name + " finished after " + delay_ms + "ms");
    pada name;
}

// Start tasks with different delays
ayanmo fast = Osa.sa({ -> task("Fast", 300) });
ayanmo medium = Osa.sa({ -> task("Medium", 600) });
ayanmo slow = Osa.sa({ -> task("Slow", 900) });

Irosu.fo("All tasks spawned, waiting...");

// Wait for specific task
ayanmo fast_result = Osa.gbogbo([fast]);
Irosu.fo("Fastest result: " + fast_result);

// Wait for all
ayanmo all_results = Osa.gbogbo([fast, medium, slow]);
Irosu.fo("All results: " + all_results);
